semanticPurpose: D1 네기마 조립 jig 위에 놓이는 빈 대나무 꼬치다. 런타임은 다섯 slot anchor에 닭·대파 모델을 닭→파→닭→파→닭 순서로 결합한다.

sourceReferences.role: user-approved D1 assembly full-screen source; direct visual reference for the bamboo's pixel contour, grain, warm palette, and jig-scale
approved empty jig and dynamic-composition contract

generation.tool: deterministic Three.js GLTFExporter with built-in imagegen texture source
generation.textureMode: source-faithful pixel-art bamboo-skewer extraction from the user-approved D1 screen
generation.promptSummary: one empty horizontal bamboo skewer only; preserve the reference's dark pixel contour, amber grain, knots, warm highlights, and tapered tip; no food, UI, jig, table, or shadow; uniform #00ff00 chroma-key background
postProcess: remove_chroma_key.py with border auto-key, soft matte, threshold 12/220, and despill
nearest-neighbor normalization to 1024×64 RGBA pixel albedo
GLB front material plane bound to the albedo while low-poly bamboo body supplies non-front-facing depth
actual GLB plus albedo rendered alone on neutral checkerboard

validation.glbParse: root origin [0,0,0]; required nodes and all five slot anchors present

contains: one MDL-SKEWER-BASE GLB with its pixel albedo

excludes: chicken, green onion, cooked skewer, jig, transfer tray, ingredient bins, background scene, character, UI, text, quantity, checkmark, shadow, or VFX
state-specific raster frames or a baked completed skewer
approvalQuestion: 빈 대나무 꼬치 모델 bundle 하나만 검토한다. 승인 D1 원본과 동일한 픽셀 윤곽·나뭇결·황갈색 명암으로 읽히는지, 빈 꼬치로 명확한지, 끝과 손잡이가 온전한지 확인한다. 닭·파와 누적 완료 모습은 이 후보에 포함하지 않는다.
nextGate: MDL-INGREDIENT-CHICKEN 한 모델을 같은 방식으로 별도 격리 검수한다.
